subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram requireMention groups retain and later expose image media from messages that did not address the bot?
rationale: Current main and the latest release intentionally skip unmentioned Telegram group media before download, while this issue asks to retain bystander media for later context; the correct default is a privacy/security product decision, not a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Keep current skip-before-download default
options.body: Leave unmentioned Telegram group media unretained unless a maintainer later sponsors an explicit opt-in retention design.

options.title: Add bounded opt-in history media retention
options.body: Implement a Telegram-specific opt-in path using HistoryEntry.media with strict image-only caps, safe storage, redacted prompt metadata, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Make retention the default
options.body: Allow later mentioned turns to inspect recent unmentioned group images by default, accepting the privacy and storage-risk change.

recommendation.title: Keep current skip-before-download default
recommendation.body: Leave unmentioned Telegram group media unretained unless a maintainer later sponsors an explicit opt-in retention design.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Telegram PR owns the current skip-before-download behavior that this decision would revise or preserve.
